notes.title: Lots of bug fixes!
notes.content:
- Connected players can now use Orella's Bank (once quest completed)
- Fast travel enabled for connected players
- Naiad cave floor improved, should be less annoying
- Fixed Client HP on connection
- Client hit messages should no longer disappear after a while
- Other players no longer 'dead' when they're alive
- Multiplayer lockpicking minigame enabled

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Gamepad Remap!
notes.content:
Fixed a bug with multiplayer spells/skills, it was a bit of a weird bug that could have been causing a few extra bugs so hopefully it's more stable now!

I've added basic support to change gamepad buttons, available in the Options menu!
